Q: Error [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:1091) A:

I verified my certificate using

openssl x509 -in file.pem -text

and found that keyUsage = Certificate Sign was missing. After creating a new certificate with keyUsage = Certificate Sign the issue was resolved.

Q: npm install Error: rollbackFailedOptional A:

Try this

npm config rm proxy
npm config rm https-proxy
npm config set registry http://registry.npmjs.org/

This error rollbackFailedOptional is often related to a network issue. This command removes any misconfigured proxy.

Q: Dot-matrix text printing A:

Most modern printers do not support plain text any longer - they expect bitmap images, unless you stick to early inkjets and/or dot matrix printers.

An alternative is to use a printer emulator running on Windows (such as QPCPrint), or our own Retro-Printer module which physically connects to the parallel port and captures the data - it can extract plain text (removing Epson control codes) or build a PDF image of the printed page.
